clips.notes: grumpy: arms loosely crossed, weight shifts L -> R with the hips leading, two huffy breaths (shoulders up, sharp sigh out), turns his chin away (neck leads, head follows) and back, the right toe taps three times, irregular blinks; coat panels and belt end settle after each shift
plain walk, ~106 steps/min: hip bob and drop, chest counter-turn, arms swing with lagging forearms; coat panels swing late

jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm (lip sync overrides it); nods on the stressed syllables; first phrase the right hand opens palm-up toward the listener, second phrase the left hand taps his chest ('me'); weight shift; two blinks

exaggerated cartoon tiptoe: high on his toes, knees lifted high and placed with care, hunched, both hands up at his chest like little paws; every step he looks back over a shoulder (left, then right), the chest turning with the head; coat panels bob
cross, heavy stamping walk: knees high, each foot slammed down flat (the body jolts on impact), fists clenched and pumping stiffly, head jutting forward, coat flapping
a little start (shoulders up, blink), then he looks up at the sky - neck first, head after - leaning back a touch; the right hand comes half up, palm up and open ('who, me?'); holds, breathing
head back, then three shrinking head shakes ('No way!'), arms snap across his chest, he turns a shoulder away from the voice with his chin up and a snort (shoulders hop); eyes half shut; holds

curled on his right side facing the viewer, knees drawn up, hands together under his cheek; two snores per loop: a long slow inhale (chest and shoulders rise, mouth falls open, head tips back a little) and a puffed exhale (mouth shuts); a foot twitch and a lip smack in the second one; eyes shut

EXTRA (not in CONTRACT §4, a lead-in for A4): from standing he yawns and stretches, kneels / sits and curls up on his right side; ends in sleep_curl frame 0. Play it before sleep_curl (S02, after the walk to CARGO)

starts in the sleep_curl pose; a last snore, then a jolt: eyes snap open, arms fling up, he springs up to sitting (overshoot back on his hands), looks left - right in a panic, scrambles to his feet (hand on the deck, knee up, push), and ends standing, wide-eyed, hands up in front ('Wha-?'), panting

head hung low, shoulders slumped forward; his right hand rubs the back of his neck (elbow out, so the face stays clear), the left hand hangs and fiddles with the coat; one long sigh; the left toe scuffs the deck; he peeks up at the captain once and drops his eyes again; heavy slow blinks

the captain grabs him under the arms from behind: he is lifted (legs dangle and pedal), pinches his nose, pulls his knees up into a cannonball with the left arm round them, is tipped over the rail backwards (bottom first), falls (eyes shut, cheeks puffed) and hits the water at frame 42 (`splash`)
clips.rootMotionNote: root travels +Z 0.10 and down to y -0.14 (frame 42 = splash, lowest point); held to the end

clips.notes: inside the fish: sits with his knees up, the left arm hugging his shins, the right hand pinching his nose; looks round the dark (left, up, right), two disgusted shudders (shoulders up, head shake); blinks

starts from sit_hold_nose's pose (the nose hand drops): he rolls forward onto his knees and sits back on his heels (small, so his head stays under the belly dome), puts his hands together in front of his chest, takes a breath, bows his head and shuts his eyes; holds, breathing. Knees on the floor (meshMinY >= -0.008)

shot out of the fish's mouth tucked in a ball: arcs down onto the sand (`touch`, frame 9), bounces, rolls over once along +X, unrolls and plonks down sitting with his legs out (`land`, frame 40), arms flung back on the sand; sways, dazed, seaweed on his head
clips.rootMotionNote: root starts 0.16 to the left (-X) and 0.05 up (out of the fish's mouth) and rolls in along +X to the mark, where he ends sitting

clips.notes: sits on the sand with his legs out, leaning back on his hands, swaying in a slow dizzy circle (head circles the other way); tilts his head right and thumps the left side of it three times with his left hand to shake the water out of his ear, then a quick head shake; heavy dazed blinks; seaweed flops
from sit_dazed's pose: pulls his feet in, rocks forward with his hands pushing off the sand, rises, brushes the sand off his coat with both hands, a little shake of the head; ends standing
a deep breath in (chest and shoulders rise, chin up), out, then one firm nod; his fists close at his sides; ends standing tall and steady

calling out to the whole city: hands cupped round his mouth (kept to the sides so the mouth shows), leaning forward from the hips, two big calls per loop, first to his left, then to his right (chest and head turn), each call pumps the body forward; jaw wide on the calls; wide stance
double-take: a glance at the gate, he looks away (it can't be...), then snaps back with a jolt - head jerks back, shoulders up, hands fly up open at his chest, jaw drops; holds wide-eyed
plonks down on the hill (a little bounce), folds his arms, chin on his chest, a huff, and taps one foot four times; eyes half shut; holds the sulk
bliss in the shade: sits with his legs out, ankles crossed, leaning back on his hands, face up, eyes closed; one long contented sigh, head sways gently, toes wiggle
over-the-top wailing at the dead plant: sitting, legs out, both arms thrown up toward it, rocking forward and back (two rocks per loop), head back, mouth wide with sobs, shoulders jerking

starts seated (legs out, as in wail / relax_happy): he lowers his arms and looks up, listening (the question sinks in), slowly gets up, sets a hand on his hip, turns his gaze to the city, and the hand slowly drops from the hip as he understands; holds standing, soft
a small, slightly shy wave: the right hand only at shoulder height, small fast waggles, shoulders up a little, head tilted, the left hand behind his back; weight rocks from foot to foot

one 6 s loop = one shipRock period: right hand resting on the steering-oar handle (at his right side), left fist on his hip, legs apart; his body sways against the ship's roll (hips lead, chest late), he looks out to sea and back, a hum (small jaw), belly breathing; blinks
big open gestures: both arms swing open wide palms-up on the stressed words (left phrase, right phrase, both), chest out, a belly chuckle (shoulders bounce), nods; jaw in a syllable rhythm
rolling sailor's walk: feet wide apart, the body rolls far over each planted foot (hips and chest roll, head stays level), arms held out from the belly and swinging wide, a bounce per step

'Welcome aboard!': a breath and a lean back, then the right arm sweeps wide in a big welcome (palm up), left fist on his hip, a laugh; then the arm swings forward and points ahead out to sea ('we're off!'); holds pointing, chest out

in the storm: both hands on the steering-oar handle at his right, heaving it hard to one side and the other (the whole body throws its weight into it, chest turning, hips pushing), legs braced wide and bent, head ducked against the wind, teeth gritted; the hands slide only +-0.02 along the static oar

bends right over Jonah lying curled at his feet (Jonah's root SHAKE_D = 0.19 in front, head toward the captain), knees bent, both hands on his upper shoulder and arm, shaking him hard in two bursts per loop, shouting (jaw wide on the bursts), eyes wide
'Throw you in? No, no!': a startled step back, both palms pushed out in front of his chest, head shaking hard twice, then the hands sink a little and the head drops, torn; holds

eyes shut, 'forgive us!': a deep breath, he bends and takes Jonah (0.10 in front, back to him) under both arms (`grab`, frame 21 = jonah_fall_in frame 0), lifts him with a grunt, rises on his toes and tips him forward over the rail (`release`, frame 44 = jonah_fall_in frame 23), follows through, then pulls both hands to his mouth and peeks with one eye
the sea goes still: his hands drop, then come up onto his head (elbows wide, face clear), jaw drops, he turns slowly to look across the calm water, a little bounce of disbelief; holds
hovering in place: gentle bob and pitch, side fins sculling (feathering on the return), a slow lazy tail sweep (body wave at low amplitude), the mouth works softly (breathing water), blinks

a body wave travelling from head to tail (relative yaw per segment, phase lag head -> tail, amplitude growing toward the tail fin), the head held steady along the travel, side fins tucked back with small strokes, dorsal fin trailing, a small bob; natural speed 0.12 units/s

spots its dinner (eyes wide, tail curls back to wind up), rises 0.10 with the nose up, the jaw opens to 55 deg, lunges 0.08 forward, SNAPS shut (`gulp`, frame 38), cheeks bulge and a swallow lump runs down the body, sinks back down and drifts back to its mark with a satisfied tail wag; holds
clips.rootMotionNote: root rises 0.10, lunges 0.08 forward (+Z), sinks back to (0, 0, 0) by the end

clips.notes: oops: the cheeks puff up, a small hop (tail flick), the jaw pops open 10 deg with the burp (`burp`), the puff goes down, an embarrassed little wiggle; ends in the idle pose

breathes in (cheeks puff), rears up with the nose high and the tail tucked under, throws its head forward and spits - jaw wide (50 deg) - with the body recoiling 0.05 backward (`spit`, frame 24), then shakes its head, shuts the mouth and settles back on its mark
clips.rootMotionNote: root rears up 0.05, recoils 0.05 backward (-Z) at the spit, returns to (0, 0, 0)

clips.notes: rolls a little onto its left side (the right fin side comes up) and flaps the right fin up and down in a big friendly wave, the left fin paddles, the tail wags slowly, happy blinks

stage.heaveMode: tandem: Jonah HEAVE_D in front of the captain, both facing the same way (captain behind him)
stage.shakeMode: Jonah (sleep_curl, facing the viewer) lies with his head toward the captain; the captain stands SHAKE_D from Jonah's root along the line of Jonah's body and faces him
